description: Declared mutants of v8-arch-big-map-engine-grid (judgment J2 of docs/architecture/plans/big-map/engine-grid.zh-Hant.md): the StaticAabbGrid broadphase in GYO::Collision and Base's strict JSON parse used by ParseVoxelMesh. Run with docs/architecture/plans/time-threads-trace/scripts/run_mutations.py --catalog docs/architecture/plans/big-map/scripts/engine_grid_mutations.json --build-dir build/target/_build/test. A mutant is killed only when its test run fails with the expected message. grid-margin-zero was first recorded as an equivalent mutant; the PR #161 reviewer's counterexample (an exact sweep reports a box just past the path's end) refuted that, and the test "a sweep that ends just short of a face on a cell line" now kills it. Test-case filters must not contain commas: doctest splits -tc on commas, and a filter that matches nothing passes.

mutants.what: A repeated key is taken silently (the DOM keeps the last): the SAX scan's check is gone
The SAX scan is not run, so repeated keys and its error message are lost
A repeated key is reported as 'not JSON' instead of naming the key
The tie rule is ignored (the lowest index always wins)
mutants.find: return tie == TieBreak::LowestIndex ? index < bestIndex : index > bestIndex;

mutants.what: An equal value never replaces (the first tested wins)
The grid has one cell too few on each axis
A query whose range ends in the first cell finds nothing
A query whose range starts in the last cell finds nothing
Candidates are neither sorted nor made unique
The ray walk stops at the first piece after any hit
mutants.find: if (best && t0 > static_cast<double>(best->distance) + Margin(t0 + LargestMagnitude(origin, origin)))

mutants.what: Capsule candidates leave out the capsule's height
mutants.find: double maximum[3]{std::max(start[0], end[0]) + r, std::max(start[1], end[1]) + capsule.height,
mutants.replace: double maximum[3]{std::max(start[0], end[0]) + r, std::max(start[1], end[1]),

mutants.what: Capsule candidates leave out the capsule's radius
mutants.find: double minimum[3]{std::min(start[0], end[0]) - r, std::min(start[1], end[1]), std::min(start[2], end[2]) - r};
mutants.replace: double minimum[3]{std::min(start[0], end[0]), std::min(start[1], end[1]), std::min(start[2], end[2])};

mutants.what: The ray's walk is clipped to the hull with the wrong side
Candidate bounds are not inflated (the exact sweep accepts a root up to 1e-12 of the path beyond its end)
mutants.find: double Margin(const double largestMagnitude) { return 1e-3 + 1e-5 * largestMagnitude; }
mutants.replace: double Margin(const double largestMagnitude) { return 0.0 * largestMagnitude; }

mutants.what: Capsule candidates come from the start position only (the end of a sweep is left out)
mutants.find: const double end[3]{start[0] + displacement.x, start[1] + displacement.y, start[2] + displacement.z};

mutants.what: GYO::Collision gains a link it must not have (Design Invariant 3)
Build accepts an infinite cell length (the isfinite part of the check is gone)
Build accepts a box that fails IsValid
Build does not count the registrations against 2^32: the 32-bit offsets wrap, caught by the assertion before the fill
